chosenReleaseCostMinusCheapestInTiedSet.unit: rankDerivedValue (release cost = base value x scarcity multiplier 1.0)

replayedLineupPointsLostByTheChosenCut.unit: best-ball lineup points per week, weeks 1-6 replay, after the incoming player lands; legal = the roster still fills as many starting slots

cutLadderTieCensus.lineupGuardIgnored: the tied set ignores the ladder's lineup-feasibility guard, which protects the COUNT of fillable starting slots (a kicker is the usual casualty), not best-ball points; the real first cut, from the owner, is what is compared
cutLadderTieCensus.ownerSignalLimit: capacity.rungOrderWasTied is True only when two or more FORCED drops tie each other, so a single forced drop never reports a tie even when dozens of candidates were tied; this census measures that
cutLadderTieCensus.note: the cheapest-legal flag path already ties on player id; this is the default path, which Perfect Draft also uses

limits: Examples are a seeded sample of trades the market calls FAIR, one per category; they show how the three quantities can differ, not how often.

Market Price is the 2026-10-25 board; League Utility is the 2026-09-09 cutoff projection prior (veterans only; rookies and players without a prior season are UNAVAILABLE); the replay is weeks 1-6 of 2026. Three dates, three evidence bases.

Team Transaction Impact is a hindsight replay of six realised weeks (Lane B measured in-sample lineup gains at about four times what walking forward realises). It is not a forecast and carries no interval.
The replay uses today's rosters over weeks 1-6, so a player acquired mid-season is credited for weeks he spent elsewhere, and a missing stat line scores 0.0 as the host does.
League Utility sums are naive per-asset sums, withheld when any asset is unscored, and biased toward the side that receives more players when the counts differ.

Forced drops come from the live capacity owner with league scarcity unread (the live multiplier is inert at 1.0); the flag-gated cheapest-legal rule is whatever the checkout defaults to, stated per example.
Nothing here is an Accept/Decline answer, a served value or a promotion.
